name: Air Kata
body:
You movements speak to the winds.

Prerequisite: Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike.

Benefit: As long as you fulfill the somatic components of a spell with the [air] subtype, you do not need to fulfill the verbal components. If you bypass the somatic component in some way (such as Still Spell), you must fulfill the verbal component normally.
